page.overview:
Who is Big Buzzy Beetle?

The Big Buzzy Beetle is giant-sized Buzzy Beetle who appears as a mini-boss in Paper Mario: Sticker Star. It resides in the caves beneath Hither Thither Hill.

The Big Buzzy Beetle is basically a giant version of smaller Buzzy Beetles.

Mario fights the Big Buzzy Beetle just as he is about to leave the mines of Hither Thither Hill. Mario must use the Battle Spinner technique in order to do some damage on the Big Buzzy Beetle since it always flips itself over right on the next turn. POW Blocks and Jump stickers are helpful in this fight. After the Big Buzzy Beetle is defeated, the way is cleared and Mario is awarded with a HP-Up Heart.

Being a large Buzzy Beetle, the Big Buzzy Beetle is very durable and is able to withstand any attack. Like any Buzzy Beetle, the Big Buzzy Beetle's weak point is it's soft underside belly but the Big Buzzy Beetle is also pretty agile and is able to get back up the moment it is flipped, to flip it over, use the Battle Spinner and get at least two matching slots (the best way to ensure this is to use the Special and Slow options which ensure you get at least two), from here, use a Jump sticker or a POW Block to flip it over (or alternatively, getting three POW Blocks on the Battle Spinner will also flip it over), then use a Jump based Sticker such as the Shiny Jump to whale on it. Make sure you use your more powerful stickers second or third because these are crucial to bringing down the Big Buzzy Beetle. Alternatively, the use of any Things you may have obtained earlier such as the Scissors or the Faucet are extremely effective as not only do they do heaps of damage but they will ignore the Big Buzzy Beetle's defensive measures and do normal damage without having to flip him over. Combining two or more Things together will also allow Mario to get a Perfect Bonus which comes with a huge Coin reward.
